relationships.title: Re: Time to chat with USAID re COVID response
relationships.evidence:
On Thu, May 6, 2021 at 3:38 PM Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Stephanie,
I hope this message finds you well! My name is Rahima and I work with Nikki Tyler at USAID's
Bureau for Global Health, in the Center for Innovation and Impact.
Along with my colleague Rachel Wood, we are conducting exploratory market
research conversations to understand how large tech companies can leverage their network,
reach, resources, and social influence to improve the COVID response in low-and-middle income
countries. We've thought through a few areas of interest, such as combatting COVID mis/dis
information, reducing vaccine hesitancy and generating demand, and leveraging in-country
employer infrastructure to provide additional sites for COVID testing or vaccination.
Would you be interested in a 30-minute discussion to explore how FB or WhatsApp are
engaging in the COVID response and potential partnership opportunities? Please let us know it
so, and l can share some potential times to discuss.
Many thanks for considering,
Rahima
-
Rahima F. Dosani, MBA, MPH (she/her)
